rules.title: CBAC scores heaped below the cut-off
Entry typed long after the visit
AI override rate far from peers
Too dark, too bright, or blown out
Very similar to another beneficiary's image
Taken well outside the encounter window
Near copy of another image in this screening
FLW and AI disagree on images
Clinician and AI disagree on images
Clinician and FLW disagree on images
CBAC score does not match its answers
PHQ-2 score does not match its answers
Symptom reported without referral to MO
PHQ-2 above cut-off without referral to CHO
AI verdict missing on an image
Visit time missing or in the future
Images or findings on a screening marked not required
